interpretation: The callback increments gz02_ssh_commands immediately after local Popen, before communicate or proof parsing. Thus one local SSH launch is established, but TCP reachability, SSH banner, pinned host-key verification, publickey authentication, remote id-u execution, and positive IPCIDR PROXY route are all unknown. run_instance wraps timeout, nonzero SSH exit, proof parse failure, post-SSH process/listener/config guard, positive route parse and witness replay failures into InstanceFailure. execute only retains the broad stage/failure_class; it discards its local negative result on exception, then deletes private stdout/stderr/config after process cleanup. The 8.7-second START-to-TERMINAL interval is not a cause proof.
